description: This file defines and manages USB device descriptors, including device, configuration, string, and endpoint descriptors, with functions to fix and retrieve descriptors, and handle USB device data structures.

methods.name: ascii7_to_utf16le
methods.description: Converts ASCII-7 string in USB string descriptor to UTF16-LE format during runtime.

methods.name: usb_get_str_descriptor_idx
methods.description: Finds the index of a string descriptor based on its memory address.

methods.name: usb_validate_ep_cfg_data
methods.description: Validates and updates endpoint address and configuration at runtime.

methods.name: usb_get_cfg_data
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration data associated with a given interface descriptor.

methods.name: usb_update_sn_string_descriptor
methods.description: Weak function to update the serial number string descriptor based on hardware info.

methods.name: usb_fix_ascii_sn_string_descriptor
methods.description: Fixes the serial number string descriptor with runtime serial number.

methods.name: usb_desc_update_mps0
methods.description: Adjusts the maximum packet size for endpoint 0 based on driver capabilities.

methods.name: usb_fix_descriptor
methods.description: Fixes and updates the overall USB descriptor, including lengths and string conversions.
